summary: Re-verified independently with a clean 'mvn clean package' (BUILD SUCCESS, 3/3 tests): the rename to de.hock.mqtt is complete (33 main + 1 test source, no src/**/com tree, groupId de.hock) with Appian's own com.appian.connectedsystems.* imports intact (55 refs, no com.appiancorp import ever existed in src), the 26.9 manifest is correct (key de.hock.mqtt, vendor Hock, version 1.0.0.0, application-version min 26.9.0.0, three de.hock.mqtt.* FQNs, key=/name= still equal to the @TemplateId names), and the single shipped jar carries 33 .java sources all under de/hock/mqtt/, appian-plugin.xml and resources_en_US.properties at the archive root, Paho only under META-INF/lib, zero test code, zero com/appian/mqtt, zero META-INF/maven, bytecode major version 61, with maven-source-plugin correctly unused.
